MISSIONS

Using headphones? Keep your phone volume low: the radio has a locked limiter, but your phone volume sits after it. Each mission sets the radio up wrong. Fix it, make a test transmission where asked, then press SUBMIT. Scoring checks what your radio actually transmitted, not just where the knobs sit.

YOUR ANSWER

STATION LOG

Attempts are saved on this device. Sending results to your instructor arrives with GreenVoice sign-in in the next phase.

YOUR VOICE

Choose what goes into the microphone when you press PTT. When you let go of PTT you hear your over played back the way the other station heard it. Try normal speech, then shout, then turn MIC GAIN up and watch the ALC meter and the spectrum.

TEST FEEDBACK

Thanks for testing the Cadet HF-1. Tell us what worked and what didn't. Please don't include personal details about yourself or anyone else.
